notes: Neap Trial Exam 2022, Mathematics Standard 2 (trial = AT4, setter NEAP). 38 questions: Section I Q1-15 (15 marks), Section II Q16-38 (85 marks); marks verified. Solutions merged from file 289 (page indexes of solution figures refer to file 289). Paper issues: (1) Q33 table prints '0.08920 cents per MJ' and '0.08330 cents per MJ', but the guideline works in dollars per MJ (3000 x 0.0892 = $267.60 > $150); the printed units should be dollars per MJ; the answer 1681 MJ only follows if the rates are dollars. Transcribed as printed; fix pending. (2) Q23 stem has a missing full stop after 'curved surface of the can' (kept as printed, with the paper's line break). (3) Q32(d) prints 'one years' time' (kept). (4) Q31(b) and Q38(c) ask for drawing on a printed grid/diagram; the blank grid and network are the question figures. (5) Q24(a) asks for a diagram with no figure in the paper. (6) Q35(c) has no text of its own; its sub-parts are stored as c.i and c.ii. (7) Q3 solution text says 'the value of 1' for a coefficient of -1 (guideline wording). Reading/writing pages, reference sheet (page 32) and extra writing pages skipped. Question and answer parts are marked as printed; old_syllabus and standard_topic left empty as instructed.
